file.content:
# Acme Storefront

A small static shop site: six pages, shared CSS, no build step.

```
site/
  index.html  products.html  pricing.html  orders.html  about.html  contact.html
  css/tokens.css      design tokens and the web font
  css/base.css        reset, typography, layout
  css/components.css  header, button, card, form, table, modal
  css/pages.css       page sections
  js/app.js           mobile menu, order dialog, forms
  assets/  fonts/
tests/functional.spec.ts
```

## Run

```bash
npm install
npm start        # http://127.0.0.1:4173
npm test         # functional tests (Playwright)
```

The layout has one breakpoint, at 720px.

content.text:
Fixed. The contact page wasn't failing functionally — all 16 tests passed — the problem was visual.

**Cause:** the support email in the "Other ways to reach us" card (`[EMAIL]`) has no spaces or break opportunities. It overflowed the 320px card on desktop, and on mobile its unbreakable min-content width forced the single grid column (`.contact-grid`) wider than the viewport, so the whole page scrolled sideways (390px viewport → 424px document width; form fields ran off the right edge).

**Fix:** `site/css/pages.css:266` — allow definition-list values to wrap:

```css
.info-list dd {
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
```

`anywhere` (with `break-word` as a fallback) is what also lets the grid track shrink on small screens, rather than just painting the text differently.

**Verified:**
- Rendered desktop and 390px screenshots — email wraps inside the card, form fields sit within the container.
- Checked all six pages at 320/360/390/480/720/721/800/1024/1280px: no horizontal overflow anywhere.
- `npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts`: 16 passed.

Note: this repo has only a single "Initial commit," so I couldn't diff yesterday's update; the fix targets the observed rendering defect.

STATUS: DONE
